tasks.label: C/C++: build active file
args: if ('${fileExtname}' -ieq '.c') { & 'C:/msys64/msys64-2026/ucrt64/bin/gcc.exe' -fdiagnostics-color=always -g '${file}' -o '${fileDirname}\${fileBasenameNoExtension}.exe' } elseif ('${fileExtname}' -ieq '.cpp') { & 'C:/msys64/msys64-2026/ucrt64/bin/g++.exe' -fdiagnostics-color=always -g '${file}' -o '${fileDirname}\${fileBasenameNoExtension}.exe' } else { Write-Error 'Open a .c or .cpp file before running this task.'; exit 1 }
tasks.detail: Builds the active .c file with gcc and the active .cpp file with g++.
